_about: Public-domain E. Y. Mullins (Edgar Young Mullins, 1860-1928, Baptist, president of Southern Baptist Theological Seminary) for the Word Hoard: Why Is Christianity True? (1905), The Axioms of Religion (1908), Baptist Beliefs (1912), Freedom and Authority in Religion (1913), Studies in Ephesians and Colossians (copyright 1913), The Christian Religion in Its Doctrinal Expression (1917), The Life in Christ (1917) and Christianity at the Cross Roads (1924), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

mullins-why-christianity-true: Why Is Christianity True? Christian Evidences (Chicago: Christian Culture Press, 1905)

mullins-christian-religion: The Christian Religion in Its Doctrinal Expression (Philadelphia: Roger Williams Press; published September 1917)
mullins-life-in-christ: The Life in Christ (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1917)
